name: Vitals Dashboard
description: Displays a comprehensive vitals dashboard with KPI metrics, trend charts, and a full server-side paginated data table for a given patient.

intent_examples: Display heart rate and sleep data
when_to_use: User wants to view a patient's vitals overview or dashboard
User asks for heart rate, blood pressure, steps, or sleep data
User wants to see health trends or charts
User wants to browse all vitals records
when_not_to_use: User wants to record or create new vitals entries
User wants to update or delete a vitals entry

introduction: Here is the vitals dashboard for this patient.

workflow_steps.name: Resolve Patient
workflow_steps.description: Silently fetches the current patient record to extract patient_id for use in subsequent steps.

workflow_steps.name: Vitals Dashboard
workflow_steps.description: Renders KPI metrics, trend charts, and a server-side paginated table of all vitals records.
